context_policy.neutral_scope: Learned typed NotMentioned only. Retrieval miss never proves whole-source insufficient evidence. Even complete source coverage does not establish semantic absence.
context_policy.numerical_checks: Exact source offsets/substrings/SHA plus numeric/date/currency/negation occurrence preservation perwindow and across fullsource partition. No semantic arithmetic/date proof, fitted confidence, or prediction override.
context_policy.selection: Main3: unchanged E50 rank-order greedy whole-unit admission, restore selected units to source order, insert newline-newline separator, no truncation/rewrite/duplicates/overlap.

whole_source.aggregation: max(1.0-pNotMentioned), exact computed-key tie earliest source-order window; select complete original3way forecast unchanged.
whole_source.failure: Singleunit>512 or >16windows rejects entire batch; no partial/neutral fallback, replacement cases or retries.
whole_source.partition: Greedy consecutive complete source units in source order, every source unit and character exactlyonce, no inserted separator within windows, no omissions or unit splitting.

hypothesis: A source-licensed contract-trained typed BERT head combined with native RuVector evidence selection can improve decisions versus matched same-model lexical, source-order and complete-source context coverage controls.
interpretation: 48 final forecasts from12cases/4document groups; actual physical forwards variable48..228, all captured and replay-scored. Descriptive uncertainty only; no fullbenchmark/officialscore/rank/publishereligibility inference.
lineage_scope: All selected officialDEV documents were available to publisher checkpoint development/early stopping. This is a development diagnostic, not a fresh model holdout. OfficialTEST identities are frozen metadata only, UNQUALIFIED_HOLD; no test non-use provenance exists.
numerical_scope: Exact supplied-source substring, number/date/currency/negation preservation only. No semantic arithmetic certificate or confidence override; retrieval miss never proves insufficient evidence.
